verdict.rationale: Vanta's API product page claims bulk operations: you can automatically upload documents or policies, bulk-assign owners to resources, mark resources out of scope, and offload employees in batches. However, this is a single marketing-level mention. The only API-reference evidence covers list and filter calls, plus single-item actions such as assigning one control owner or attaching one evidence file. It is unclear whether bulk work runs as native batch endpoints or as client-side looping. Missing for 10: documented bulk/batch API endpoints with limits and semantics, evidence that the MCP server or AI agent can apply actions across many items at once, bulk operations in the UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
